title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Premium and Billing Schedule
content:
# Utility Line Protection Plans — Premium and Billing Schedule

Issued by Billing Operations for the customer care center. Each Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plan is priced and billed at the figures below; the figures apply to every plan of that tier.

## Schedule by plan

| Plan | Monthly premium | Discount for paying the term premium in full up front | Term length | Returned payment fee | May be billed on a partner utility's bill |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | $6.49 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | $5.49 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | $10.99 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | $11.99 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | $15.99 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | $24.99 | 0.08 (8 percent) | 12 calendar months | $25.00 | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Monthly premium** — the plan premium in US dollars for one monthly billing period.
- **Up-front discount** — the discount that applies when the premium for the whole term is paid in full up front, expressed as a decimal fraction of twelve monthly premiums.
- **Term length** — the length of each term in calendar months.
- **Returned payment fee** — the fee in US dollars billed when a premium payment is returned unpaid.
- **Partner utility billing** — whether the plan may be billed on a partner utility's bill.

## Reading the schedule

- The six plans differ in monthly premium only; the up-front discount, the term length, the returned payment fee and the availability of partner utility billing are the same on every plan.
- The discount is a fraction of twelve monthly premiums of the plan held, so on every plan it is 8 percent of twelve times that plan's monthly premium.
- Every plan may be billed on a partner utility's bill.
